original_benchmark.notes: Google DeepMind DeepSearchQA (DSQA-full.csv). Graded by an LLM autorater (Gemini 2.5 Flash) with the official Kaggle starter-notebook prompt; per-prompt precision/recall/F1, F1 primary.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on a 100-prompt stratified subset (--split parity, seed 42), 3 runs per side, FrontierAgent ReAct single agent on both sides, judge zai-org/glm-5.3-flash. F1 original 93.87 ± 0.79 vs Harbor 91.28 ± 0.40; run ranges do not overlap (see README and parity_experiment.json for the investigation). Codex generalization run (codex@0.172.0, same model and judge, 1 run): F1 96.83, fully correct 89.0%. Parity cost about $180 in model API usage (agent ~$176 at aiand list prices, judge ~$2); web search (Parallel) and page reading (Jina) are billed separately and not included.
